events.title: The Portrise Idle demo is out now!
events.summary: Hello, idle game fans! You can now download the Portrise Idle demo from the main game’s Steam page. Give it a try and let me know what you think — I hope you enjoy it!Combat expeditions will be expanded and better balanced in the full release.Your feedback means a lot to me. After defeating the boss, please take a short survey — you’ll find the link in the game. I’d really appreciate it!

events.title: Expeditions Gameplay Demo & Development Update
events.summary: I’m excited to share a gameplay demo of Expeditions. Experience a short roguelike-style challenge in the endgame. events.title: A new perspective on the store and a small devlog.
events.summary: Hello everyone! This is Alex Bald. After working with an artist, we replaced all the capsules in Steam. Now the appearance in the store matches how I see it. A short devlog: at the moment, I’m actively working on the endgame content. I really want to implement a feature where players will open a conditional chest, get an item from it, and sell it on the Steam marketplace. events.title: Portrise Idle - announce trailer
events.summary: Hello to all idle game fans! The Portrise Idle trailer was released quite recently, and the Steam page has also been updated with new gameplay videos in the description. Check out the trailer showcasing the gameplay and some of the game’s features! A few little sneak peeks: A Steam Inventory with collectible items is plannedSome light endgame content in the form of a roguelike mode with rewardsAtmospheric music is included! Thank you all so much!
